nd89bb99047.headline: GSR III Acquisition Corp. Announces the Closing of its  $230 Million Initial Public Offering, Including Full-Exercise Of Over-Allotment Option
nd89bb99047.summary: GSR III Acquisition Corp. closed its initial public offering of 23,000,000 units at $10.00 each, including full exercise of the over-allotment option, for gross proceeds of $230 million.
nd89bb99047.why: A special purpose acquisition company raises capital through an IPO to find and merge with a private company, offering investors exposure to future deal outcomes.

na90284ba3d.headline: Economic storm brewing as govt hikes duty on fuel
na90284ba3d.summary: The Zimbabwean government increased duty on fuel to raise revenue, a move one critic called atrocious and warned could create an economic storm.
na90284ba3d.why: Fuel duties feed directly into pump prices and transport and production costs, affecting inflation and household spending.

n8e0bb7fea8.headline: How the Federal Reserve's latest rate cut will impact Americans
n8e0bb7fea8.summary: The Federal Reserve cut its benchmark interest rate by a quarter of a percentage point. Local coverage says the move will affect Americans through borrowing and savings costs.
n8e0bb7fea8.why: The Federal Reserve sets US policy interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, equity valuations and the dollar across global markets.
n8e0bb7fea8.why_moved: The quarter-point cut lowers the policy rate, which typically pulls down short-term Treasury yields and reduces borrowing costs.

n7b237224a3.headline: How to make the perfect paella
n7b237224a3.summary: Finance Minister Imbert said there will be no devaluation of the TT dollar. He argued that devaluation would not increase the availability of foreign exchange in the country.
n7b237224a3.why: Currency policy affects import costs, foreign-exchange availability and inflation in Trinidad and Tobago's economy.

n78d3efa14b.headline: Dutch Bros CEO lays out the coffee chain's cross-country expansion plans
n78d3efa14b.summary: Dutch Bros, which listed in 2021, operates in 18 US states including California, Arizona and Texas. The CEO laid out its expansion plans across the country.
n78d3efa14b.why: Dutch Bros is a US drive-through coffee chain, and its growth plans indicate expansion in the US quick-service restaurant sector.

nee25462184.headline: Brazil-Africa: A partnership renewed?
nee25462184.summary: The Brazil-Africa Forum in São Paulo showed a willingness to deepen relations. Bilateral trade still lags and is dominated by natural resources.
nee25462184.why: Brazil and Africa trade commodities such as iron ore, oil and agricultural goods, so trade volumes shape export demand for Brazilian firms.

ne39d6a1396.headline: Exarchou (AKTOR): The best time to be active in construction in Greece
ne39d6a1396.summary: AKTOR Group Chairman Exarchou said the group is implementing a strategy to build its position in the Greek construction market.
ne39d6a1396.why: AKTOR is a Greek construction and concessions group, so its market strategy reflects conditions in Greece's infrastructure and construction sector.

n8118b0fdb3.headline: Onion farmers record over 50% post-harvest losses, warns of rising prices
n8118b0fdb3.summary: NOPPMAN says Nigerian onion farmers face post-harvest losses above 50% due to high production costs, climate challenges and poor storage, warning of rising prices.
n8118b0fdb3.why: Onions are a staple food crop, and post-harvest losses reduce supply and can push up food prices in Nigeria's inflation-sensitive economy.

n20bc73d787.headline: Is Germany still able to act on foreign policy?
n20bc73d787.summary: Germany's governing coalition has collapsed over budget issues, including increased aid to Ukraine. The conservative opposition could ensure policy continuity.
n20bc73d787.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and its budget and government stability shape EU fiscal policy, defence spending and investor sentiment in the euro area.

n5074464fb6.headline: EU reels from Trump win, German Cabinet's fall
n5074464fb6.summary: Germany's governing coalition has imploded just as the European Union needs leadership most. Donald Trump's election victory and political uncertainty in Berlin point to a volatile period ahead.
n5074464fb6.why: Germany is the largest economy in the euro area, so political instability there affects EU policy and the euro. Trade relations with the U.S. are central to European business.

nce050432cc.headline: WestProp acquires US$1m brick manufacturing facility
nce050432cc.summary: WestProp has acquired a US$1 million brick manufacturing facility, according to an interview at the 2024 Ideas Festival in Nyanga. Details of the deal were limited.
nce050432cc.why: Building materials manufacturing supports the construction and property sectors, which are sensitive to local construction demand and financing.

nd0387096fc.headline: ECB trials: France issues first DNN on Euroclear's DLT platform
nd0387096fc.summary: A EUR100 million digitally native note was issued on Euroclear's platform and settled through the Banque de France's DL3S platform, part of an ECB trial.
nd0387096fc.why: Euroclear is a major European securities settlement house, and digital bond issuance is an emerging test of how post-trade infrastructure may change.

na9d5b0ffc9.headline: Panic not inflation is under control: RBZ
na9d5b0ffc9.summary: The Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe says the current concern is panic rather than inflation, and remains confident that stabilising gold prices will help restore economic balance.
na9d5b0ffc9.why: The central bank's communication shapes inflation expectations and confidence in the local currency. Zimbabwe's economy is sensitive to gold prices given its mineral exports.

nea9db6b991.headline: Lithuanian car exporter fails to pay €13.6m fine for sanctions breach
nea9db6b991.summary: Vilnius-based vehicle exporter Biovarda has failed to pay a €13.6 million fine imposed by the Lithuanian Customs for a sanctions breach.
nea9db6b991.why: Sanctions enforcement affects exporters' compliance costs and trade flows, particularly for goods routed to restricted markets.

n2813c7b5db.headline: Ammonnews : 22.8% achievement of Economic Modernization Vision priorities by September's end
n2813c7b5db.summary: By the end of September, 22.8% of Economic Modernization Vision priorities had been achieved, with 76 priorities postponed, according to Ammon News.
n2813c7b5db.why: Jordan's Economic Modernization Vision is the government's reform roadmap, and its progress affects investor confidence in the kingdom's economy.

n9bb5bb047e.headline: Aer Lingus reports drop in operating profits and blames pilots’ strike action
n9bb5bb047e.summary: Aer Lingus reported a third-quarter operating profit of €139 million and blamed pilots' strike action for the drop in profits.
n9bb5bb047e.why: Aer Lingus is an Irish airline and a subsidiary of International Airlines Group, operating transatlantic and European routes.

ne7b591d2b8.headline: Zesa reels under US$430 million debt
ne7b591d2b8.summary: Zimbabwe's state power utility Zesa is reported to have US$430 million in debt. A Sinohydro official warned that the mounting debt could lead to operational halts.
ne7b591d2b8.why: Zesa is Zimbabwe's main electricity utility, so payment problems affect power supply to households and industry. Sinohydro is a Chinese state-owned construction contractor.

n4ccce2b98a.headline: Cityscape Global in Saudi Arabia to Introduce Over 100,000 Housing Units
n4ccce2b98a.summary: The Cityscape Global exhibition opening Monday in Riyadh is expected to introduce more than 100,000 housing units. Financing options start at 2.59% interest, and the event includes a real estate auction valued above SAR 1 billion.
n4ccce2b98a.why: Saudi housing development is a core part of the Vision 2030 economic diversification program, drawing large real estate and mortgage activity.

n54ec33ae70.headline: Swiggy IPO Day 3: Online food delivery giant's Rs 11,300 crore issue gets fully subscribed | Indiablooms - First Portal on Digital News Management
n54ec33ae70.summary: Swiggy's IPO was fully subscribed on its final bidding day, Friday, November 8, after a lukewarm response in the first two days. The offering was worth Rs 11,327.43 crore.
n54ec33ae70.why: Swiggy is a major Indian online food delivery and quick-commerce platform, and its listing is a key test for new technology issues in India.

n7736382149.headline: I’ve paid N90bn out of inherited debt without borrowing — Gov Otti
n7736382149.summary: Abia State Governor Alex Otti said his administration has paid off N90 billion of the N191.2 billion debt inherited from the previous government, without borrowing.
n7736382149.why: Subnational debt management affects state budgets, fiscal capacity and creditworthiness in Nigeria.

nba3a0f5995.headline: Octopus Energy giving certain customers extra £200
nba3a0f5995.summary: Octopus Energy has extended a customer fund so that certain customers receive an extra £200. The extension now includes people over State Pension age who do not receive Pension Credit.
nba3a0f5995.why: Octopus Energy is a UK energy supplier, and support schemes for households affect retail energy costs and regulatory scrutiny in Britain.

n97f342d8f0.headline: ZiG recovery fails to boost confidence
n97f342d8f0.summary: The ZiG's international currency code ZWG depreciated rapidly against the US dollar between September and October. The report says a recent recovery has failed to boost confidence.
n97f342d8f0.why: The ZiG is Zimbabwe's local currency, and its stability drives inflation, pricing and the value of local assets for investors exposed to the country.

nb432401c22.headline: State of the Retail Nation Q3: Consumer confidence starts to recover ahead of Black Friday - NielsenIQ
nb432401c22.summary: NIQ South Africa's State of the Retail Nation analysis shows consumer confidence starting to recover ahead of Black Friday. It shows healthy revenue prospects for FMCG and tech and durables retail for the first nine months of 2024.
nb432401c22.why: Retail sales trends in fast-moving consumer goods and durables give investors a read on household spending and the earnings outlook for South African retailers.

n4b93a2b1da.headline: EM bond funds see largest weekly outflow in two years, JPMorgan report says
n4b93a2b1da.summary: Retail investors pulled $3.2 billion out of emerging market bonds this week, the largest outflow in 109 weeks, JPMorgan said. Hard currency funds accounted for $2.9 billion of the outflow.
n4b93a2b1da.why: Emerging market bonds are debt issued by developing economies, and fund flows indicate investor appetite for their borrowing costs and currencies.

n397ee75763.headline: After Trump Win, EU Leaders Tackle 'Urgent' Reform Agenda
n397ee75763.summary: Mario Draghi, author of a major report on the EU economy, warned that reform is urgent after Donald Trump's US election win, ahead of talks with EU leaders in Budapest.
n397ee75763.why: Mario Draghi's report set out the EU's economic reform agenda, which shapes European growth, competitiveness and investment policy.

n47e2b67a30.headline: JD Wetherspoon boss issues price rise warning to customers
n47e2b67a30.summary: Tim Martin, chairman of JD Wetherspoon, warned customers of price rises following the autumn Budget.
n47e2b67a30.why: JD Wetherspoon is a large UK pub chain, and its pricing reflects cost pressures such as taxes and wages.

nffcf4eaf98.headline: Donald Trump would ‘certainly’ do trade deal with UK, says Boris Johnson
nffcf4eaf98.summary: Former UK prime minister Boris Johnson said Donald Trump would certainly do a trade deal with the UK. Keir Starmer's government is working to smooth over tensions with the president-elect.
nffcf4eaf98.why: Trade agreements between the UK and the US set tariffs and market access that affect British exporters and investors.

n1e83c8649c.headline: Wallix:  target positive operating income by 2025
n1e83c8649c.summary: Wallix confirmed its targets after reporting continued hyper-growth in recurring revenues over the first nine months of the year. The cybersecurity software company's figures run to September 30, 2024.
n1e83c8649c.why: Wallix is a French cybersecurity software company, and its profitability targets are watched by investors in European software stocks.

nf128501495.headline: BOST Clears over GH¢300m Debt
nf128501495.summary: The Bulk Energy Storage and Transportation Company said it has repaid 100% of its trade debt and loan obligations, totaling over GHS 384 million. Its managing director spoke in Accra.
nf128501495.why: BOST is Ghana's state-owned bulk fuel storage and transport company, handling petroleum supply logistics in the country.

entities.name: Bulk Energy Storage and Transportation Company (BOST)

nce09f9d4a4.headline: Ashford Hospitality Trust Refinances Marriott Hotel Loan
nce09f9d4a4.summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust refinanced the mortgage on the Marriott Crystal Gateway Hotel in Arlington, Virginia, with a $121.5 million non-recourse loan at SOFR plus 4.86%. It generates $31 million in excess proceeds.
nce09f9d4a4.why: Ashford Hospitality Trust is a US lodging REIT owning hotels, so its debt terms and refinancing affect its financial flexibility.

na3419a2c9d.headline: China Approves $840B Plan to Refinance Local Government Debt, Boost Economy
na3419a2c9d.summary: China approved a 6 trillion yuan ($839 billion) plan to help local governments refinance their debt. The plan will be implemented over the next three years, according to a National People's Congress official.
na3419a2c9d.why: Local government debt is a major financial risk in China, and refinancing plans influence credit conditions and growth in the world's second-largest economy.

n11d6f3cf85.headline: JD Wetherspoon boss issues price rise warning to customers
n11d6f3cf85.summary: Wetherspoon chairman Tim Martin has warned customers of price rises after the autumn Budget. The pub operator's warning follows the UK government's fiscal statement.
n11d6f3cf85.why: JD Wetherspoon is a large UK pub chain, so its pricing plans reflect cost pressures from tax and wage changes in the UK hospitality sector.

n75f53a9fe5.headline: Sensex  falls! These  stocks fell 5% or more in Friday
n75f53a9fe5.summary: In the Nifty pack, 23 stocks closed higher while 27 ended lower, with several stocks falling 5% or more in Friday's session.
n75f53a9fe5.why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 large Indian companies and is the main benchmark for the country's equity market.

n250201c226.headline: Investors gain N217bn on positive trading
n250201c226.summary: Investors on the Nigerian Exchange gained N217 billion in wealth at the close of trading on Thursday, as the All-Share Index rose.
n250201c226.why: The Nigerian Exchange is the main venue for trading Nigerian listed equities, and its index tracks overall market value.

n9b8a422c2e.headline: Adopt alternatives to interest rate hikes, treasurers urge govt
n9b8a422c2e.summary: The Association of Corporate Treasurers of Nigeria called on the Federal Government to explore other ways of tackling inflation without relying on interest rate hikes.
n9b8a422c2e.why: Interest rate decisions by Nigeria's central bank shape borrowing costs, the naira and corporate funding conditions.

n4e586fe69b.headline: We've Paid N90bn From N191bn Inherited Abia Debt — Otti
n4e586fe69b.summary: Abia State Governor Alex Otti said his administration has paid about N90 billion of the N191 billion debt it inherited on assuming office.
n4e586fe69b.why: State debt levels and repayments affect a Nigerian state's fiscal capacity and its ability to fund public spending.

nd3eec05d56.headline: Advanced Drainage Systems Announces Second Quarter Fiscal 2025 Results
nd3eec05d56.summary: Advanced Drainage Systems announced financial results for its second quarter of fiscal 2025. The company is a provider of stormwater and onsite septic wastewater management products.
nd3eec05d56.why: Advanced Drainage Systems is a US manufacturer of water management products, and its quarterly results indicate demand in stormwater and construction markets.

n205ffd5510.headline: People's Bank of China launches “visual hard wallet” in attempt to boost digital yuan adoption · TechNode
n205ffd5510.summary: The People's Bank of China launched a digital yuan visual hard wallet at the 18th Shenzhen International Financial Expo. The card is 1mm thick.
n205ffd5510.why: The digital yuan is China's central bank digital currency, and adoption affects the future role of payments and the yuan in China's financial system.

n06334e4607.headline: Fiscal policy was a squabble too far for German coalition’s odd throuple
n06334e4607.summary: Disagreements over fiscal policy strained Germany's three-party coalition, with the parties at times appearing to govern three different countries. The Guardian describes the dispute as a squabble too far.
n06334e4607.why: Germany's budget and fiscal stance shape growth expectations for Europe's largest economy and the euro area.

n5a4ca94a83.headline: President Trump, Kiwibank, unemployment, Treaty principles
n5a4ca94a83.summary: Donald Trump easily defeated Democratic rival Kamala Harris in the US presidential election, a result that confounded polls predicting a much closer race.
n5a4ca94a83.why: The US presidency shapes trade, tax, regulation and fiscal policy, all of which feed into global markets.

source.name: NBR | Business news & analysis | Independent, ad-free reporting

sources.name: NBR | Business news & analysis | Independent, ad-free reporting

n5a4ca94a83.why_moved: The result beat expectations set by polls that had predicted a much closer contest, shifting policy expectations.

n6d65208092.headline: SBI Q2 earnings: Profit climbs 28%, NII at Rs 41,620 crore  - BusinessToday
n6d65208092.summary: State Bank of India reported a 28% rise in profit for the second quarter. Net interest income rose to Rs 41,620 crore from Rs 39,500 crore a year earlier.
n6d65208092.why: State Bank of India is India's largest lender by assets, so its results are a bellwether for the banking sector.

n6a9af993a7.headline: Rupee weakens to record low, logs worst week in five months
n6a9af993a7.summary: The Indian rupee weakened to a record low on Friday and logged its worst weekly fall since May. Pressure came from sustained outflows from local stocks and expectations of a stronger dollar after Donald Trump won the US election.
n6a9af993a7.why: The rupee's value affects India's import costs, inflation and the returns foreign investors earn on Indian assets.

impacts.name: Indian rupee
impacts.why: The rupee weakened to a record low against the dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n6a9af993a7.why_moved: Sustained outflows from local stocks and expectations of a stronger dollar after the US election pressured the rupee.

nffc553ee72.headline: Taiwan Must Improve Chip Tech to Stay Ahead, Cliff Hou Says
nffc553ee72.summary: Taiwan should invest more resources in advancing chip technology and expanding its supply chain expertise, an influential trade group said. The remarks came after Donald Trump's election as US president.
nffc553ee72.why: Taiwan is central to global semiconductor manufacturing, so its chip competitiveness affects technology supply chains worldwide.

na6d0efd25b.headline: Austria’s Arduous Path to a New Government: Without the Far-Right
na6d0efd25b.summary: Austria is working to form a new government without the far-right party, after a period of political uncertainty. The article focuses on the path to a coalition.
na6d0efd25b.why: Government formation affects Austria's fiscal policy, eurozone commitments and the outlook for its economy.

n817eb5b426.headline: Icahn Enterprises Hits Rough Patch With Q3 Earnings Miss, Dividend Cut; Eyes Larger Stake In CVR Energy
n817eb5b426.summary: Icahn Enterprises reported third-quarter earnings of 5 cents per unit against 21 cents expected, and sales of $2.22 billion below the $2.32 billion consensus. The company also plans a larger stake in CVR Energy.
n817eb5b426.why: Icahn Enterprises is a diversified holding company with investments spanning energy, automotive and other sectors.

n67feea827a.headline: Ashok Leyland expects to record one of the best years in exports this fiscal: Hinduja Group
n67feea827a.summary: Ashok Leyland expects one of its best export years this fiscal, and plans to enter four new Southeast Asian markets, including the Philippines and Malaysia. The expansion is part of its export strategy.
n67feea827a.why: Ashok Leyland is a major Indian commercial vehicle maker, and its export growth reflects demand for trucks and buses abroad.

nbc3b6324c8.headline: 'More of the same': Jobless rate holds steady at 6.5% in October amid weak hiring
nbc3b6324c8.summary: Canada's jobless rate held steady at 6.5% in October as employers added a modest 15,000 jobs. Economists said the weak hiring is not severe enough to prompt concern at the Bank of Canada.
nbc3b6324c8.why: The Canadian labour market data shapes expectations for Bank of Canada interest-rate decisions, which affect the Canadian dollar and bond yields.

na877de1eef.headline: Wall Street Fed Watchers Dial Back 2025 Rate-Cut Expectations
na877de1eef.summary: Economists and strategists across Wall Street have dialed back expectations for US interest-rate cuts next year following this week's presidential election of Donald Trump.
na877de1eef.why: Expected Federal Reserve rate cuts drive Treasury yields, borrowing costs and equity valuations. Shifts in rate expectations are a central input for investors pricing US assets.
na877de1eef.why_moved: Lower expectations for rate cuts reduce the outlook for easier monetary policy, which typically pushes Treasury yields higher.

na8160e7a13.headline: Canadian dollar falls as jobs miss keeps jumbo rate cut in play
na8160e7a13.summary: The Canadian dollar fell against the US dollar as oil prices dropped and weak domestic employment data supported bets on another outsized Bank of Canada rate cut.
na8160e7a13.why: The Canadian dollar is sensitive to oil prices and Bank of Canada policy, and both affect exporters, borrowers and cross-border investment returns.
na8160e7a13.why_moved: Weak jobs data and falling oil prices raise expectations of a larger Bank of Canada rate cut, which weighs on the loonie.

ncf056ce632.headline: Federal government faces potential loss if Trans Mountain pipeline sold: PBO
ncf056ce632.summary: The Parliamentary Budget Officer estimates the Trans Mountain pipeline's current value is below the sum of its assets, exposing taxpayers to potential billions of dollars in losses on a sale.
ncf056ce632.why: Trans Mountain is a crude oil pipeline system owned by the federal government of Canada. Its sale value affects public finances and the operation of Western Canadian oil export capacity.

nd8830ce590.headline: Swiggy IPO: Issue sails through on Day 3, QIB portion booked 4x; GMP further falls - BusinessToday
nd8830ce590.summary: Swiggy's IPO, priced at Rs 371-390 per share, was subscribed on day three with the qualified institutional buyer portion booked 4 times. Grey market premium fell further.
nd8830ce590.why: Swiggy is a Bengaluru-based food and quick-commerce delivery platform, and its public listing is a major test of appetite for new consumer-tech issues in India.

nec53261791.headline: Asia stocks sputter as focus shifts to China stimulus
nec53261791.summary: Asian stocks reduced early gains on Friday as investors awaited details of China's stimulus measures.
nec53261791.why: China is the world's second-largest economy, and its stimulus policy influences regional equities, commodities and global growth expectations.

nd5947bc164.headline: South African rand slips against stronger dollar
nd5947bc164.summary: The South African rand declined against the dollar, tracking the dollar's strength in global markets.
nd5947bc164.why: Currency movements affect South Africa's trade competitiveness and inflation, impacting investors in the region.

n82d27c38be.headline: Coordinating relief: Support Lebanon’s urgent humanitarian needs
n82d27c38be.summary: Lebanon's displacement crisis worsens with over 872,000 internally displaced and refugees fleeing to Syria, driven by Israeli attacks.
n82d27c38be.why: Regional instability and humanitarian crises can influence economic stability and foreign aid flows.

ne23f78faa2.headline: Expect a slower pace of easing from Bank of England
ne23f78faa2.summary: The Bank of England's decision to cut interest rates to 4.75% reflects a cautious approach due to slowing inflation and wage growth.
ne23f78faa2.why: Interest rate movements influence borrowing costs, inflation, and currency stability in the UK and globally.

n13ef059b66.headline: World Bank announces USD 750M support package for Ukraine – PM
n13ef059b66.summary: The World Bank has announced a new USD 750 million support package for Ukraine to aid economic stability and development efforts.
n13ef059b66.why: Ukraine's economic stability is critical for regional security and development, and the support impacts international aid flows and investor confidence.

na0413bf4d5.headline: South African Markets – Factors to watch on Nov 8
na0413bf4d5.summary: South African assets recouped losses ahead of a bond auction and company results, influencing local markets.
na0413bf4d5.why: South Africa's economic indicators and corporate earnings impact investor sentiment and currency stability in the region.

nb8391ee206.headline: Main Street Area Plan: Old Town redevelopment must balance history, functionality
nb8391ee206.summary: The Park City Council reviews a vision for Old Town's future, focusing on urban development and preservation.
nb8391ee206.why: Urban redevelopment plans can influence local real estate markets and infrastructure investments.

n58f5859ce7.headline: Douglas: Yes, there will be another vote in 2028
n58f5859ce7.summary: A political analyst predicts Ghana will hold another presidential election in 2028, indicating ongoing political stability.
n58f5859ce7.why: Political stability and electoral cycles influence economic policy, investor confidence, and currency stability.

n88e52b85c8.headline: Southeast Asia prepares for Trump's tariff threats
n88e52b85c8.summary: Leaders in Southeast Asia are bracing for potential US tariffs and shifting alliances following Donald Trump's reelection prospects.
n88e52b85c8.why: US trade policies directly impact regional exports, supply chains, and economic stability in Southeast Asia.

n47a6226c5f.headline: Most Americans expect Donald Trump to increase US debt, poll finds
n47a6226c5f.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll indicates most Americans believe President-elect Donald Trump will raise US debt levels.
n47a6226c5f.why: Expectations of increased US debt influence bond markets, currency, and fiscal policy outlooks.

nb5ce6530e5.headline: Orascom Financial approves in principle the offer from Clever Holding
nb5ce6530e5.summary: Orascom Financial Holding has approved in principle a purchase offer from Clever Holding Limited for 59.39 million shares, representing 98.99% of the company's capital.
nb5ce6530e5.why: A near-total stake acquisition typically leads to a change of control and may result in delisting or a mandatory offer process, which matters to minority shareholders.

n02fa3569a6.summary: Lithuanian development institution ILTE, formerly Invega, will work with the European Investment Fund to provide up to 250 million euros in loans to Lithuanian businesses.
n02fa3569a6.why: The European Investment Fund is an EU body that supports small and mid-sized enterprise financing. Such programmes affect credit availability for local companies.
